qa_pairs.question: How can a single Ansys Additive Manufacturing replay file be used across multiple directories on a cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: A single Ansys Additive Manufacturing replay file can be utilized in different directories by opening it in a text editor and modifying its internal FilePath setting.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user check the resource utilization of an Ansys Additive Manufacturing job once it's running on a cluster's compute node(s)?
qa_pairs.answer: Once an Ansys Additive Manufacturing job has been running for a few minutes, a snapshot of its resource utilization on the compute node(s) can be obtained using the `srun --overlap --jobid=myjobid top -bn1 -u $USER | grep R | grep -v top` command.
